name: Wardx
description: Wallet-native perpetuals trading terminal on Lighter.
longDescription: Wardx is a wallet-native perpetuals trading terminal built on Lighter. The trading view combines a TradingView chart, a live order book, and an order form with market and limit orders, take-profit and stop-loss triggers, all on one screen. A bottom panel shows positions, assets, open orders, order history, trade history, and funding history. Users connect a wallet and open a session, then deposit, trade, and withdraw from their own account; Wardx is self-custodial and never takes custody of funds. Portfolio, orders, wallet, and referrals pages cover account management, with a market picker, settings drawer, light and dark themes, and live market data. Trades are attributed to Wardx's Lighter integrator account (737590).
